exposure.needed: whether the environment has custom setups that depend on reading the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from Strimzi pods or Services

original.statement: The statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label has been removed from Strimzi-managed pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services; custom setups depending on this label should use strimzi.io/pod-name instead.

decision.reason: [ev-4fdefdd841ec] says only environments with a "custom setup leveraging such label" are affected, and that they should switch to `strimzi.io/pod-name`. Such setups could be label selectors, monitoring or external tooling, and no static input reliably shows them. An undecidable exposure that names this dependency is the right condition. A narrower static predicate, such as Service selectors, would miss exposed environments. The reason code could arguably be environment-visibility-gap instead of runtime-behavior-gap, but the condition and what it needs are correct.
